pr_title: fix not updating the nav view when add/removing profiles
pr_body:
* make the list of MenuItems observable, so the nav view can actually listen for changes to it
* Use the MenuItemsSource to find the index to add at, rather than the MenuItems (which isn't accurate anymore)
* Stash a single observable vector as the menuitemsource, and modify that whenever we need to do modifications.
  * I attempted to create a new vector, then copy into the new one, then replace the MenuItemsSource with the new vector, but that _refused_ to work. So let's just... not.

Regressed in #14630
Closes #15140

Manually validated that this and #13673 are still fixed
pr_comments: uh, this is weird. now discard/save bring you back to the Startup page. and when I discard, my first profile disappears and is replaced with a hole:
I love that I can pull the unpackaged distribution from your build and just run it as-is
The only issue I had was that it forgot the nav view scroll position... but that's better than crashing.

### Expected Behavior

_No response_

### Actual Behavior

It does not show up (or disappear.)

review_comments: This can only be null for a brief part of the ctor. The ctor pretty quickly calls `_InitializeProfilesList`, which on it's first call, also calls `_MoveXamlParsedNavItemsIntoItemSource`, which initializes `_menuItemSource`. So someone would have to break that first, for `_menuItemSource` to ever be null
